lines.text: Yet He commanded the clouds above
and opened the doors of the heavens.
He rained down manna for them to eat;
He gave them grain from heaven.
Man ate the bread of angels;
He sent them food in abundance.
He stirred the east wind from the heavens
and drove the south wind by His might.
He rained meat on them like dust,
and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
He felled them in the midst of their camp,
So they ate and were well filled,
for He gave them what they craved.
Yet before they had filled their desire,
with the food still in their mouths,
and He put to death their strongest
and subdued the young men of Israel.

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, Polderlandschap — the low country lying under a sky that is nearly all of the picture, or rely on His salvation, yet He commanded the clouds above
pictures.name: pd_vangoyen_polderlandschap

pictures.scene: Francesco Bacchiacca, The Gathering of the Manna — the people out early stooping to pick up the bread that was given them, and opened the doors of the heavens, He rained down manna for them to eat
pictures.name: pd_bacchiacca_gathering_of_manna

pictures.scene: Emile Claus, De bietenoogst — the harvest lifted out of the ground and carried in by everyone together, He gave them grain from heaven, man ate the bread of angels
pictures.name: pd_claus_de_bietenoogst

pictures.scene: Hendrick Martensz Sorgh, Markt am Hafen — the market on the quay covered with more than the people can carry away, He sent them food in abundance, He stirred the east wind from the heavens
pictures.name: pd_sorgh_markt_am_hafen

pictures.scene: Bruno Liljefors, Wild Geese Settling — the flock coming down out of the sky onto the water in numbers, and drove the south wind by His might, He rained meat on them like dust
pictures.name: pd_liljefors_wildgeese_settling

pictures.scene: Philips Wouwerman, Een legerkamp — the tents pitched together and the whole camp spread out around them, and winged birds like the sand of the sea, He felled them in the midst of their camp
pictures.name: pd_wouwerman_een_legerkamp

pictures.scene: Annibale Carracci, Der Bohnenesser — the man bent over his bowl eating as fast as he can, all around their dwellings, so they ate and were well filled
pictures.name: pd_carracci_bohnenesser

pictures.scene: Antonio de Pereda, El sueño del caballero — the man asleep among everything he wanted while the angel stands over him pointing, for He gave them what they craved, yet before they had filled their desire
pictures.name: pd_pereda_sueno_del_caballero

pictures.scene: Jules Dupré, Cattle in the Limousin — the beasts standing at the water under a sky that has turned heavy, with the food still in their mouths, God's anger flared against them
pictures.name: pd_dupre_cattle_limousin

pictures.scene: Wilhelm Kotarbiński, The Widow of Nain — the young man carried out of the gate and his mother walking behind, and He put to death their strongest, and subdued the young men of Israel
pictures.name: pd_kotarbinski_widow_of_nain
